Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 26 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 20 July 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales, Pampanga and Tarlac(Capas, Bamban, Concepcion, Tarlac City, La Paz).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Batangas, Cavite and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Nueva Ecija, Quezon and Tarlac(Anao, Gerona, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, San Jose, Santa Ignacia) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
